digest.component_or_area: test infrastructure: subprocess and network sentinels
propositions: Blanket autouse _short_timeout fixture with 1s timeout causes five reap tests to waste ~1.01s each waiting for deadline expiry; fixture must be split into separate opt-in fixtures for hanging vs completing child tests.
test_run_acli_429_retries_with_rate_limit_backoff inherits 1s timeout ceiling as implicit pass condition, creating latent load flake where two sequential spawns must complete within that bound.

Three reap tests assert on child-side setup (grandchild pidfile, spawn counter, flushed stdout) whose ordering depends on 1s window exceeding interpreter startup, a wall-clock race that fails under load; ordering must be made explicit via readiness gates instead.
tight_stall fixture injects 2s low-speed window even though sibling dribble test proves git honors 1s window; must be lowered to 1s.
Production timeout defaults (120s call / 3s grace / 2s drain / 10s low-speed window) must remain unchanged; only test-only values are modified.
Tests must complete in low single-digit seconds on CI while retaining real subprocess/socket execution and discrimination power against seeded defects.
